Lockheed Martin is seeking an experienced Software Engineer to support ground software for the Next Generation Geospatial OPIR mission. The role focuses on Tier 2 operational support, troubleshooting and resolving high-priority issues, and designing, implementing, and testing new software capabilities.

Working within a team to design, implement, and test new software capabilities

Required
* 1+ years experience with one or more of the following: Java, Python, and C++ programming languages
* Proficiency in SQL
* Familiarity with Angular framework
* Proven experience troubleshooting issues in Software and infrastructure
* Ability to work seamlessly in a collaborative multi-team environment
* Proven ability to convey technical details to non-technical audiences
* Active Secret government clearance with ability to gain TS/SCI non-polygraph
Preferred
* Knowledge of Agile Software Development
* Experience using observability tools (i.e. Splunk) to trace transactions across microservice architecture
* Experience with Message Broker and cross domain REST communication emphasizing Cyber Security and Reliability
* Experience working within a modern micro-service architecture
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Aerospace Engineering or other related degree from an accredited college/university
* Familiarity with OpenShift
* Proven ability to triage, investigate, and resolve defects
